verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a 0-day data retention policy with vendors/partners and Private Storage options for Enterprise customers to control where data is stored, plus admin rules engine for meeting access/privacy. However, there is no documented self-service deletion API/mutation, no per-user data export/delete controls, and no explicit retention configuration UI described in evidence. missing for 10: user/API-level deletion controls, granular retention configuration beyond enterprise private storage, independent confirmation of retention practices.
